record.title: Federal BSA/MSB registration plus bounded New York authorization route
kv: 31 U.S.C. section 5330 and the FinCEN MSB registration framework; New York's separate virtual-currency authorization framework.
The proposed payment or value-transfer activity may fall within the federal MSB registration perimeter and/or covered New York virtual-currency activity.
Financial Crimes Enforcement Network (public body); New York State Department of Financial Services (public body)
Financial Crimes Enforcement Network for federal MSB registration; New York State Department of Financial Services for its New York virtual-currency authorization framework

Classify the activity and territorial nexus. Determine whether FinCEN MSB registration applies. For New York activity, identify the exact license/charter, approved scope, conditions, and current status.

Federal MSB registration is not a nationwide operating license; NYDFS evidence is a bounded New York route and does not resolve other states' requirements or securities, commodities, banking, sanctions, or consumer-protection law.
Financial Crimes Enforcement Network: FinCEN publishes the federal MSB registration framework.
New York State Department of Financial Services: NYDFS publishes the New York virtual-currency authorization framework and directory.
